corrections.text: The article states that AI capabilities like "text and image understanding and generation" were something "Apple described," citing TechCrunch. TechCrunch's article actually attributes this characterization to Alibaba: "Alibaba confirmed the company's news to CNBC in a statement... It also said the integrations would involve AI capabilities like 'text and image understanding and generation.'" SCMP and MacRumors corroborate that this description came from Alibaba's own statement about Qwen's capabilities, not from Apple.
